placements.why: Shipping the async decision widget is the product's decision-capture mechanism reaching production, and the Zephyr integration is named as the technical unlock that made shipping it possible — both are evidence feeding the existing theme that the product captures decisions at the moment of consensus, rather than letting them evaporate into scrollback.

A sprint velocity figure is an organizational-strategy fact (team execution health), not a positioning or product-capture theme — none of the existing narrative leaves are about internal delivery performance, and strata is currently empty, so this is exactly the one real category this envelope's content calls for.
placements.title: Delivery evidence as its own organizational lens
placements.theme: Concrete execution metrics — velocity, throughput, technical unlocks — get tracked as evidence of momentum, distinct from positioning or product-feature narrative.

placements.title: The team's shipping pace is climbing sprint over sprint
placements.theme: Rising sprint velocity is itself evidence that the team's execution capability is accelerating, independent of any single feature shipped.
placements.why: A single quarter-high velocity number is a fact, not a leaf on its own — but sprint retros will keep reporting this metric over time, making 'the team's execution pace is increasing' a genuine recurring subject rather than a one-off statistic. No existing leaf (all about positioning or decision-capture) plausibly holds it, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Proof strata rather than left to sprawl as its own untethered category.
